wake.name: Wake
wake.title: Waker of the Bloom
wake.desc: Wake the Bloom and let it see the healed world. It opens its arms: everything it kept comes out to play, and it plays rough.

unbound.desc: Wild creatures turn up 60% more often, and enemies have 10% more health.

sever.name: Sever
sever.title: Tethercutter
sever.desc: Cut the tether. Nothing the Bloom keeps will regrow again, and nothing it holds can be held against its will.

unbound.desc: Coin from the Bloom is 30% richer, and enemies hit 15% harder.

sing.name: Sing
sing.title: Last Singer
sing.desc: Take Ilsa's place in the song and sing the Bloom back to sleep, gently this time.

unbound.desc: Enemies doze until they hear you, but wake with 20% more health.

rules.name: Hardened
rules.desc: Enemies have 15% more health.

rules.name: Quickened
rules.desc: Enemy bullets fly 20% faster.

rules.name: Brittle Cages
rules.desc: Cages fail 25% of the time.

rules.name: Ricochet
rules.desc: Enemy bullets split in two when they hit a wall.

rules.name: Thin Blood
rules.desc: All healing is 30% weaker.

rules.name: Twisted Rooms
rules.desc: Every fight room has a room twist.

rules.name: Elite Guard
rules.desc: Every room's first enemy is an elite.

rules.name: No Peddlers
rules.desc: No peddlers set up shop.

rules.name: Short Night
rules.desc: Two minutes less on the clock.

rules.name: Bloomlords Stir
rules.desc: A Bloomlord may wait at the bottom instead of a boss.

rules.name: Regrowth
rules.desc: Enemies regrow 1% of their health a second.

rules.name: Darkness
rules.desc: The Hollow Choir's dark falls on every floor.

rules.name: Gales
rules.desc: Wind lanes blow through every room.

rules.name: Venom Tide
rules.desc: Poison pools seep into every room.

rules.name: Eruptions
rules.desc: Lava vents open in every room.

rules.name: Fury
rules.desc: Enemies deal 25% more damage.

rules.name: Fragile Bonds
rules.desc: Companions take 20% more damage.

rules.name: Barren
rules.desc: Chests hold half as much.

rules.name: Swarm
rules.desc: Two more enemies in every room.

rules.name: Unbound
rules.desc: Everything has 25% more health and hits 25% harder.

deaf.desc: Guns do 30% damage; companions and melee do full.

reflect.desc: Half of every elemental hit comes back on whoever applied it.

brood.desc: Can't be hurt while any of its brood lives.

mirror.desc: Sends shadow copies of your companions in first, again when enraged.

classes.name: Finest {type} genome
classes.desc: The highest total of combat grades.

classes.name: Best {type} under Gen {n}
classes.desc: Total grades, for a creature below Gen {n}.

classes.name: Most striking {type}
classes.desc: Rare looks: shine, pattern, size and hue.

twists.name: Season of Tides
twists.desc: Tide creatures turn up twice as often.

twists.name: Season of Embers
twists.desc: Ember creatures turn up twice as often.

twists.name: Season of Glass
twists.desc: Crystal creatures turn up twice as often.

twists.name: Season of Song
twists.desc: Echo creatures turn up twice as often.
